newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Futures Exch to add CITIC, Swire stocks futures.
newsitem.headline: HK Futures Exch to add CITIC, Swire stocks futures.

text.p: Hong Kong Futures Exchange said on Thursday two stocks futures contracts, CITIC Pacific Ltd and Swire Pacific A futures contracts, would be opened for trading on May 23.
"We selected CITIC Pacific Ltd and Swire Pacific A because both are blue chip stocks with a broad range of investors," said chief executive officer Ivers Riley in a statement.
"Moreover, unlike the existing three Stock Futures contracts, they belong to a different category," Riley added.
Riley said there seemed to be increased interest from locals, which indicated a growing acceptance of the product by the public.
